seo.descriptionOverride: Speakers from Under Armour and Hulu will discuss how they utilize data to create unique personalization experiences across channels.
seo.descriptionRendered: Speakers from Under Armour and Hulu will discuss how they utilize data to create unique personalization experiences across channels.

flexible_post_content.text_editor:
Join us on Wednesday, August 18, 2021 at 3 pm ET to hear Data Scientist, Personalization and Content Recommendations expert at Hulu, Afshaan Mazagonwalla and Senior Manager Global SEO at Under Armour, Dana Tan discuss how leading brands drive qualified traffic to their site, optimize experiences for conversions and leverage personalization to make a greater impact on performance. SEO Team Lead at Foresight Digital, Priyanka Gaunder will moderate the discussion.

We’re excited to partner with Foresight Digital, to bring these dynamic speakers together to offer practical insights and inspiration on what it takes to maximize relevant inbound traffic once it hits your website.

Watch the recording
